WITH Tree AS (
    -- ── Anchor: the run itself ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT
        CAST(r.ID AS NVARCHAR(50))                          AS NodeID,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))                          AS ParentNodeID,
        0                                                   AS Depth,
        0                                                   AS Sequence,
        CAST('Run' AS NVARCHAR(20))                          AS NodeType,
        CAST(COALESCE(r.RunName, r.Agent, 'Agent Run') AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS Name,
        CAST(r.Status AS NVARCHAR(50))                       AS Status,
        r.StartedAt                                          AS StartedAt,
        r.CompletedAt                                        AS CompletedAt,
        CAST(r.TotalCost AS DECIMAL(19, 8))                  AS Cost,
        r.TotalTokensUsed                                    AS Tokens,
        r.TotalPromptTokensUsed                              AS PromptTokens,
        r.TotalCompletionTokensUsed                          AS CompletionTokens,
        CAST('MJ: AI Agent Runs' AS NVARCHAR(100))           AS SourceEntity,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))                           AS PromptRunID,
        -- The action equivalent, so an Action task can point at its execution log.
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))                           AS ActionLogID,
        -- A task's payloads, so a workflow step can present the same before/after diff an agent
        -- run step does. Without them the shared detail panel has nothing to compare and falls
        -- back to a raw dump, which is the difference someone notices immediately.
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX))                          AS InputPayload,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX))                          AS OutputPayload,
        -- A loop step's per-pass trace, carried through the recursion and expanded into nodes in a
        -- second SELECT below (APPLY is illegal inside a recursive member).
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX))                          AS Iterations,
        -- What KIND of work this node is, in its own vocabulary: a run step's StepType
        -- ('Prompt', 'Actions', 'Sub-Agent', 'Validation', …) or a task's ('Agent', 'Action',
        -- 'ForEach', 'While', 'Human', …). Carried because every visual consumer colours and
        -- icons by kind — without it a renderer can only draw undifferentiated boxes, which is
        -- what forced the visualizations to keep reading raw step rows.
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))                           AS SourceKind,
        -- Authoring order, used as the sort tiebreak. See the ORDER BY at the bottom.
        r.__mj_CreatedAt                                     AS CreatedAt
    FROM [__mj].[vwAIAgentRuns] r
    WHERE r.ID = {{agentRunID_2 | sqlString

SELECT

    cd.*,

    u."UserImageURL",
    u."UserImageIconClass",

    -- Agent Runs as JSON array (0-1 per conversation detail)
    (
        SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
            'ID', ar."ID",
            'AgentID', ar."AgentID",
            'Agent', ar."Agent",
            'ParentRunID', ar."ParentRunID",
            'ContinuationDepth', ar."ContinuationDepth",
            'Status', ar."Status",

            'TotalCompletionTokensUsed', ar."TotalCompletionTokensUsed",
            'TotalCost', ar."TotalCost",
            'ConversationDetailID', ar."ConversationDetailID"
        ) ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ar."ParentRunID" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
            COALESCE(ar."ContinuationDepth", 0) ASC,
            ar."__mj_CreatedAt" DESC)::text
        FROM __mj."vwAIAgentRuns" ar
        WHERE ar."ConversationDetailID" = cd."ID"
    ) AS "AgentRunsJSON",

              FROM "ReadableArtifacts" ra

ReadableArtifacts AS (
    SELECT a_root.ID, 0 AS Depth
    FROM [__mj].[vwArtifacts] a_root
    WHERE (a_root.DelegateEntityID IS NULL OR a_root.DelegateRecordID IS NULL)
      AND (
          a_root.UserID = {{Context.UserID_2 | sqlString}}
          OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM [__mj].[vwArtifactPermissions] ap
              WHERE ap.ArtifactID = a_root.ID
                AND ap.UserID = {{Context.UserID_2 | sqlString}}
                AND (ap.CanRead = 1 OR ap.CanEdit = 1 OR ap.CanDelete = 1 OR ap.CanShare = 1)
          )
          OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM [__mj].[vwCollectionArtifacts] ca
              INNER JOIN [__mj].[vwArtifactVersions] av_ca ON ca.ArtifactVersionID = av_ca.ID
              INNER JOIN ReadableCollections rc ON ca.CollectionID = rc.ID
              WHERE av_ca.ArtifactID = a_root.ID
          )
      )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT child_art.ID, ra.Depth + 1 AS Depth
    FROM [__mj].[vwArtifacts] child_art
    INNER JOIN [__mj].[vwEntities] e_del ON child_art.DelegateEntityID = e_del.ID AND e_del.Name = 'MJ: Artifacts'
    INNER JOIN ReadableArtifacts ra ON LOWER(CAST(ra.ID AS NVARCHAR(36))) = LOWER(child_art.DelegateRecordID)
    WHERE ra.Depth < 8
      AND child_art.DelegateRecordID IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    -- Conversation Detail fields (all fields needed for display)
    cd.*,

    -- User Avatar fields from vwUsers (for message display)
    -- These fields come from the LEFT JOIN to User table in vwConversationDetails
    u.UserImageURL,
    u.UserImageIconClass,

    -- Agent Runs as JSON array (0-1 per conversation detail)
    -- Only includes fields needed for display in the gear icon
    (
        SELECT
            ar.ID, 
            ar.AgentID,
            ar.Agent,
            ar.ParentRunID,
            ar.ContinuationDepth,
            ar.Status,
            ar.__mj_CreatedAt,
            ar.__mj_UpdatedAt,
            ar.TotalPromptTokensUsed,
            ar.TotalCompletionTokensUsed,
            ar.TotalCost,
            ar.ConversationDetailID
        FROM [__mj].[vwAIAgentRuns] ar
        WHERE ar.ConversationDetailID = cd.ID
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ar.ParentRunID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
            ISNULL(ar.ContinuationDepth, 0) ASC,
            ar.__mj_CreatedAt DESC
        FOR JSON PATH
    ) as AgentRunsJSON,

    -- Artifacts as JSON array (0-N per conversation detail)
    -- Only includes fields needed for display in artifact cards
    -- Excludes heavy Content field for performance
    (
        SELECT
            cda.ConversationDetailID,
            cda.Direction,
            av.ID as ArtifactVersionID,
            av.VersionNumber,
            av.Name as VersionName,
            av.Description as VersionDescription,
            av.__mj_CreatedAt as VersionCreatedAt,
            av.ArtifactID,
            a.Name as ArtifactName,
            a.Type as ArtifactType,
            a.Description as ArtifactDescription,
            a.Visibility as Visibility
        FROM [__mj].[vwConversationDetailArtifacts] cda
        INNER JOIN [__mj].[vwArtifactVersions] av ON cda.ArtifactVersionID = av.ID
        INNER JOIN [__mj].[vwArtifacts] a ON av.ArtifactID = a.ID
        WHERE cda.ConversationDetailID = cd.ID
          AND cda.Direction = 'Output'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM ReadableArtifacts ra
              WHERE ra.ID = a.ID
          )
        ORDER BY cda.__mj_CreatedAt, av.VersionNumber
        FOR JSON PATH
    ) as ArtifactsJSON,

    -- Ratings as JSON array (0-N per conversation detail)
    -- Includes all user ratings for multi-user support
    (
        SELECT
            cdr.ID,
            cdr.UserID,
            cdr.Rating,
            cdr.Comments,
            cdr.__mj_CreatedAt,
            u.Name as UserName
        FROM [__mj].[vwConversationDetailRatings] cdr
        INNER JOIN [__mj].[vwUsers] u ON cdr.UserID = u.ID
        WHERE cdr.ConversationDetailID = cd.ID
        ORDER BY cdr.__mj_CreatedAt DESC
        FOR JSON PATH
    ) as RatingsJSON

        INNER JOIN __mj."vwConversationDetailRatings" cdr ON cdr."ConversationDetailID" = cd."ID"
        WHERE cd."ConversationID" = c."ID" AND cdr."Rating" >= 8

        SELECT 1 FROM __mj."vwConversationDetails" cd
        INNER JOIN __mj."vwConversationDetailRatings" cdr ON cdr."ConversationDetailID" = cd."ID"
        WHERE cd."ConversationID" = c."ID" AND cdr."Rating" <= 3
    ))::int AS "HasNegativeRating",

    (NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM __mj."vwConversationDetails" cd
        INNER JOIN __mj."vwConversationDetailRatings" cdr ON cdr."ConversationDetailID" = cd."ID"
        WHERE cd."ConversationID" = c."ID"
